Fusion Settings corresponding source and build access

The owner-test package's package.json identifies the exact fusion-windows source commit used to build it. The corresponding product source is available from:
  https://github.com/choicky/fusion-windows/tree/<sourceCommit>
Replace <sourceCommit> with package.json.sourceCommit. The source includes src/settings/main.cpp and dbusprovider.cpp, the Host settings API, tests, build scripts, and pinned-source manifest. The package supplies the separate fcitx5-qt patch in source/settings-patches/.

The settings build uses these exact upstream/fork revisions (also recorded in cmake/settings-ui/versions.cmake):
  configtool upstream base: https://github.com/fcitx/fcitx5-configtool/tree/9bd6022c6f5f768d32b6dbe2012358e4cdb1116b
  maintained configtool adaptation PR: https://github.com/choicky/fcitx5-configtool/pull/2, branch windows/fusion-settings, commit abc2c6644b030d761d3d5e7c27c888af019e63f0
  pinned configtool fork commit: https://github.com/choicky/fcitx5-configtool/tree/abc2c6644b030d761d3d5e7c27c888af019e63f0
  fcitx5-qt source base: https://github.com/fcitx/fcitx5-qt/tree/0285a5d18367d8f3af80dab7e4819d5555982340
  fcitx5: https://github.com/fcitx/fcitx5/tree/a7f2528773ebfec98a20c49b6eea2333110b1c88
  fcitx5-chinese-addons: https://github.com/fcitx/fcitx5-chinese-addons/tree/61474bd3aa9fca26d1c31df93343035697e9f265
  libime: https://github.com/fcitx/libime/tree/171edcf137001e8eb8274f53ec010058cda70b09
  Qt: 6.8.3, win64_msvc2022_64, qtbase archive (open-source LGPL-3.0-only license path)
  ECM: 6.30.0, build time only; vcpkg commit and native dependency pins follow tools/fcitx/build-native.ps1.

Build from a clean source checkout on Windows x64/MSVC:
  1. Install the Visual Studio C++ workload and Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0. Make CMake/Ninja, MSVC, SDK, and UCRT paths available only to the build process; do not change machine/user PATH.
  2. Prepare the owner-test build-tool cache using the WP4-pinned vcpkg tree and Visual Studio C++ workload/Windows SDK paths documented with the product build prerequisites. Qt 6.8.3 / `win64_msvc2022_64` is retrieved using the task's managed `aqtinstall` environment.
  3. Run tools/fcitx/build-native.ps1 -Configuration Release -WorkRoot <task-local runtime root> (with its process-only Visual Studio environment switch) or use the integrated owner-package script.
  4. Run tools/settings/build-settings.ps1 with the resulting runtime root, Qt root, ECM/vcpkg root, and a fresh task-local BuildRoot. It checks out exact pinned commits from the owner-maintained configtool fork and upstream fcitx5-qt, applies only the separate fcitx5-qt portability patch, then compiles FusionSettings.exe.
  5. Run ctest for the product build and use tools/package/build-package.ps1 to assemble the owner-test ZIP. The package manifest hashes every file. Scripts do not write system/user PATH, install/register an IME, or install the package.

The package includes the fcitx5-qt patch, the three LGPL runtime source directories/corresponding-source links from the existing Stage 6 WP4 source-access arrangement, and these build instructions. It does not bundle vcpkg, Qt SDK build tools, full upstream Git histories, or build intermediates. The pinned configtool fork commit itself contains the configtool adaptations; its GitHub URL plus the Fusion product commit provide the complete source inputs. License notices are in licenses/settings-ui/ and licenses/runtime/.
